subject: Social Media
title: Info Wars as Geopolitics
description: Learn Info Wars as Geopolitics in one minute.

hook.text: Russia calls it 'information confrontation.' China calls it 'discourse power.' Both see social media as a battlefield.

buildup.text: Traditional warfare costs billions and risks soldiers. Information warfare costs thousands and is deniable.

discovery.text: A single viral post can damage a nation's reputation, tank its currency, or shake an alliance. Words are weapons now.

twist.text: The U.S. does it too. Every major power runs influence operations. The difference is scale, not principle.

climax.text: Social media turned every citizen into a potential target and a potential weapon. The frontline is your feed.

punchline.text: The new wars aren't fought with guns. They're fought with feeds.

quiz.question: Why do nations prefer information warfare over traditional warfare?
